column1: # Curated places the GeoNames population filter drops: real, verified
# populated places whose GeoNames record carries population 0, so no
# cities*. dump can ever include them (cities500 = population > 500).
# Each row is copied from the GeoNames country dump (CC-BY 4.0) and
# cites the geonameid it was verified against; a row without a
# verifiable geonameid does not belong here.
#   geonameid  name  latitude  longitude  country-code  timezone  population  region
# `population` is GeoNames' own estimate (0 = none carried); `region`
# is provenance for the human verifying the row — gen-cities ignores
# it. gen-cities skips a row whose geonameid the primary cities15000
# dump already carries, so a place that later gains a population
#   2478073  Tamokra  P PPL  36.39322  4.66446  admin1 18 (Béjaïa), admin2 2507644 (Daïra d'Akbou)
